name: Trailing Activate Close All
summary: This EA is a trade management utility that applies trailing stop functionality to open positions and provides a close-all feature to liquidate all open trades. It does not open trades on its own but rather manages existing positions by dynamically adjusting stop loss levels as price moves favorably. The close-all function acts as an emergency exit or risk control mechanism.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个交易管理工具，主要功能是对已有持仓应用移动止损（追踪止损），并提供一键全平仓功能。它不会自主开仓，而是通过动态调整止损水平来管理现有仓位，全平仓功能则作为紧急退出或风险控制手段。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是移动止损管理，即当价格朝有利方向移动时，逐步将止损位向盈利方向推移以锁定浮盈。入场条件方面，该EA本身不产生入场信号，而是依附于用户已有的持仓进行管理。出场条件由移动止损触发——当价格回撤至追踪止损水平时自动平仓锁定利润，或者通过手动调用全平仓功能强制关闭所有仓位。仓位管理方面，该EA不涉及开仓仓位大小的计算，仅管理已有仓位的止损水平。资金管理方面，移动止损本身就是一种资金管理手段，通过限制回撤来保护已实现和未实现的利润。该EA的风险控制高度依赖用户对追踪止损参数的合理设置，包括追踪距离和激活阈值等关键参数。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of this EA is trailing stop management, which progressively moves the stop loss level in the favorable direction as price advances to lock in unrealized gains. Regarding entry conditions, the EA does not generate its own entry signals but instead attaches to existing user positions for management. Exit conditions are triggered when the trailing stop is hit — price retraces to the trailed stop level resulting in automatic position closure with locked profit — or via the close-all function which forcefully liquidates all open positions. In terms of position sizing, the EA does not calculate or determine lot sizes for new entries since it only manages stop loss levels of existing positions. For money management, the trailing stop mechanism itself serves as a risk management tool by limiting drawdown and protecting both realized and unrealized profits. The overall risk control effectiveness heavily depends on the user's proper configuration of trailing stop parameters, including the trailing distance and activation threshold.

pros: 移动止损功能有效锁定浮动利润，降低盈利回吐风险
全平仓功能提供紧急风险控制手段，在极端行情下快速清仓
作为工具型EA不自主开仓，不会增加额外风险敞口
pros_en: Trailing stop effectively locks in floating profits and reduces the risk of giving back gains
Close-all function provides emergency risk control for rapid liquidation during extreme market conditions
As a utility EA it does not open positions independently, avoiding additional risk exposure
cons: 参数设置不当可能导致止损过紧被正常波动触发或过松失去保护作用
缺少对点差和滑点的考虑，在高波动市场可能执行不佳
功能较为单一，缺少可视化面板和实时状态显示
cons_en: Improper parameter settings may cause stops that are too tight and triggered by normal volatility or too loose to provide meaningful protection
Lacks consideration for spread and slippage, which may result in poor execution during high-volatility markets
Functionality is relatively limited, lacking a visual panel and real-time status display
improvements: 增加可视化面板显示当前追踪止损状态和持仓信息
添加点差过滤和多级别追踪止损支持，提升在极端行情下的执行质量
improvements_en: Add a visual dashboard displaying current trailing stop status and position information for better user awareness
Implement spread filtering and multi-level trailing stop support to improve execution quality during extreme market conditions

risk_points: 全平仓功能可能在滑点较大时无法按预期价格执行
移动止损参数设置不当可能过早止损或保护不足
risk_points_en: The close-all function may not execute at expected prices during significant slippage
Improperly configured trailing stop parameters may result in premature stop-outs or insufficient protection
